correctness.rationale: The published ordered-pair characterization reduces the problem to strict distance witnesses. For every i not equal to j, the exact witness set favoring a_i over a_j is {a_i,b_j}, which forces the complement classification. Explicit witnesses prove sufficiency, and exhaustive checking of 349504 subsets for n=3 through 9 confirms the theorem and enumerator.
